Scoring & data

Each revealed pick contributes its role-specific normalized matchup or synergy delta. Effects are adjusted by games ÷ (games + 1,000), multiplied by your Settings role weights, then added. Unknown slots contribute nothing. Candidates with missing active pair data are left unranked. A 0× role weight ignores that slot. “Include base WR” adds the candidate's overall win rate above 50%.

Team draft edge adds each unique allied synergy pair once and every ally-versus-enemy matchup. It includes the selected preview or your locked pick, plus each ally?s base strength when enabled. Synergy pairs use the average of their two role weights. Missing active data leaves the team total unavailable.

This score ranks draft fit. Adding pair effects has not been validated as a prediction of game win probability. Pair samples overlap, and the fixed sample adjustment is a conservative setting rather than a fitted model.

Blindability ranks counterpick safety from 0 to 100 within your role. Negative enemy matchup deltas are adjusted by sample size, multiplied by opponent pick-rate share within each role, then added across five enemy roles. Rare picks count less. Base win rate, positive bonuses, and teammate synergy do not affect this score. It is independent of draft edge. Hover its number for matchup and synergy graphs. The graphs show observed deltas and a noise-corrected spread, which is separate from the score.

Draft stats come from a saved, non-live snapshot.
